own_solution.law: Unity power factor: Im(Y_total) = 0, omega*C = omega*L/(R^2 + omega^2 L^2), so C = L/(R^2 + omega^2 L^2)
assumptions: ideal sinusoidal supply and ideal capacitor
series R-L model of the motor

notes: omega = 100*pi = 314.159 rad/s; omega*L = 15.708 ohm; R^2 + (omega L)^2 = 100 + 246.740 = 346.740 ohm^2; C = 0.05/346.740 = 1.44202e-4 F. With 17.5 ohm: 306.25 + 246.740 = 552.990; C = 9.0418e-5 F. Supply voltage scales both branch currents equally and cancels from the phase condition (C). Lamp resistors and earlier-test resistors have no path. TED3D and T81DD are numeral-free controls.
